a.lede: Google is adding a new feature to its underwhelming HiLight light on the back of Pixel 11 Pro phones: as part of the November 2026 Pixel Drop, the light can light up when you get Google Messages texts from your favorite contacts. Sure, it's a small addition to the disappointing ways you could use HiLight […]
a.title: Google is making Pixel HiLight slightly more useful

b.lede: November's Pixel Drop also brings other AI features to older Pixel phones, while the Pixel 11's HiLight feature now works with Google Messages.
b.title: Google's impressive Rambler dictation tech is now available on Pixel 10 devices too
